name: Beltram
classification_notes: A bold, versatile grotesque sans built across six weights with italics, placing it in the standard grotesque category.
summary: A confident grotesque sans in six weights with italics, anchoring the wider Beltram type system.
description: Beltram is a bold grotesque sans developed over five years, running Light through Black with matching italics for a full 12 styles. It anchors a wider family that includes a monospaced cut and the display variant Dolph.
foundry_blurb: Domicile Foundry list Beltram as a 12-style family, priced from single styles to a full family licence, designed by Joona Louhi between 2018 and 2023.

name: Beltram Mono
classification_notes: The fixed-width companion to Beltram, sharing its grotesque structure but built for tabular and code use, placing it in the mono category.
summary: The monospaced companion to Beltram, in six weights with italics.
description: Beltram Mono carries the parent family's grotesque structure into a fixed-width form, running Light through Black with italics for 12 styles in total.
foundry_blurb: Domicile Foundry list Beltram Mono as a 12-style family designed by Joona Louhi between 2018 and 2023, priced from single styles to a full family licence.

name: Chauffeur
classification_notes: A compressed grotesque sans available only in a narrow width, placing it in the condensed grotesque category.
summary: A compressed grotesque sans built as a variable font, running five weights with italics.
description: Chauffeur is a tightly compressed grotesque, developed over eight years and shipped as ten static styles plus a variable font covering weight and slant. Its narrow width makes it suited to tight headline space and editorial packaging.
foundry_blurb: Domicile Foundry describe Chauffeur as a 2016-2024 family with 10 styles plus a variable font, designed by Joona Louhi.

name: Dolph
classification_notes: A display variant of the Beltram grotesque system running across three experimental width groups, placing it in the grotesque display category.
summary: A display offshoot of the Beltram system, split into three differently-proportioned width groups.
description: Dolph takes the Beltram family into more experimental territory, split into three width groups named KOO, KAA and YY, each running four weights with italics for 24 styles in total.
foundry_blurb: Domicile Foundry list Dolph as part of the Beltram family, a 24-style release from 2020 to 2024 designed by Joona Louhi, sold as three separate width groups.

name: Larsen
classification_notes: A single-weight grotesque offered across four widths from condensed to extended, placing it in the grotesque display category.
summary: A single-weight grotesque display face spanning four widths from condensed to extended.
description: Larsen keeps a single Bold weight but runs it across Condensed, Narrow, Standard and Extended widths, giving four distinct headline styles from one grotesque skeleton.
foundry_blurb: Domicile Foundry list Larsen as a 2019-2022 release with 4 styles, designed by Joona Louhi and covering Bold Condensed through Bold Extended.

name: Louche
classification_notes: An extremely condensed, high-contrast sans with fashion-magazine styling, placing it in the display category despite its sans construction.
summary: An ultra-condensed, high-contrast display sans with a fashion-magazine sensibility, in five weights.
description: Louche is a tightly condensed display sans with extreme stroke contrast, closer to a fashion masthead face than a working text sans. Five weights run Regular through Black.
foundry_blurb: Domicile Foundry list Louche as a 2019-2024 release with 5 styles, designed by Joona Louhi, running Regular through Black.

name: Rondeau
classification_notes: A wide-ranging grotesque sans spanning Thin to Black with italics, placing it in the standard grotesque category with unusually broad range.
summary: A wide-ranging grotesque sans running from Thin to Black with matching italics.
description: Rondeau is Domicile Foundry's broadest grotesque, developed over eight years to cover seven weights with italics for 14 styles, giving it enough range for both text and display use.
foundry_blurb: Domicile Foundry list Rondeau as a 2017-2025 release with 14 styles, designed by Joona Louhi, running Thin through Black.
